overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief regular meeting on August 12th, approving three contractor pay estimates and a concrete license before moving into closed session to deliberate on claims. All items passed unanimously with minimal discussion.
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not identified by name in the transcript

agenda.item: Item 1: Approval of minutes from August 4th regular Board of Public Works meeting
Item 2A: 2026 Asphalt Paving Project — ARC Pavers Pay Estimate No. 3 ($322,718.16)
Item 2B: Downtown Utility Project — Haas Sons Incorporated Pay Estimate No. 3 ($136,498.03)
Item 2C: Portland Cement Concrete License — Ross Construction
Item 3: Motion to enter closed session per Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(g) to deliberate on claims

discussions.body: A board member moved to approve the minutes of the August 4th regular Board of Public Works meeting, which was seconded and passed unanimously with no discussion.

discussions.item: 2026 Asphalt Paving Project — ARC Pavers Pay Estimate No. 3
discussions.body: The board considered Pay Estimate No. 3 from ARC Pavers in the amount of $322,718.16 for the 2026 asphalt paving project. A motion to approve was made and seconded, passing unanimously with no additional discussion.

discussions.item: Downtown Utility Project — Haas Sons Incorporated Pay Estimate No. 3
discussions.body: Pay Estimate No. 3 from Haas Sons Incorporated in the amount of $136,498.03 for the downtown utility project was brought before the board. A motion to approve was made and seconded, passing unanimously without debate.

discussions.item: Portland Cement Concrete License — Ross Construction
discussions.body: A board member stated they had reviewed the Portland cement concrete license application from Ross Construction and moved to approve it. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously.

discussions.item: Closed Session to Deliberate on Claims
discussions.body: The board voted unanimously to enter closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(g) for the purpose of deliberating on claims. No details about the nature of the claims were disclosed in open session.
